action-wikikgextractor-review: Action text shown in a MediaWiki permission error when a user cannot review WikiKG claims.
right-wikikgextractor-review: Label for the wikikgextractor-review permission in rights lists.
wikikgreviewedgraph: Special page title. Make clear this is one page of reviewed snapshots, not a global graph.
wikikgreviewedgraph-intro: Explains the 50-snapshot page bound, source-access checks, possible later pages, and that approval does not establish scientific correctness.
wikikgreviewedgraph-empty: Empty state. Say clearly that no eligible claims appear on this page of stored snapshots.
wikikgreviewedgraph-load-error: Generic fail-closed error when reviewed graph data cannot be loaded.
wikikgreviewedgraph-invalid-offset: Error for an invalid reviewed graph pagination offset.
wikikgreviewedgraph-properties-heading: Heading above the table of approved scalar property claims.
wikikgreviewedgraph-relationships-headin: Heading above the table of approved relationship claims.
wikikgreviewedgraph-subject: Table header for a claim's subject entity.
wikikgreviewedgraph-property: Table header for a scalar property predicate.
wikikgreviewedgraph-value: Table header for a scalar property value. Conflicting claims remain separate rows.
wikikgreviewedgraph-relationship: Table header for a relationship predicate.
wikikgreviewedgraph-object: Table header for a relationship's object entity.
wikikgreviewedgraph-qualifiers: Table header for claim qualifiers such as season, level, or conditions. Values are escaped and kept with the individual claim.
wikikgreviewedgraph-review: Table header for a link to the existing review detail page.
wikikgreviewedgraph-open-review: Link text to the corresponding claim review record.
wikikgreviewedgraph-link: Link to the reviewed snapshot pages, shown on the review list and extraction result to avoid requiring a rerun.
wikikgreviewedgraph-previous: Link to the previous page of claim snapshots.
wikikgreviewedgraph-next: Link to the next page of claim snapshots.
wikikgreviewedgraph-page-limit: Notice that additional snapshots exist beyond the hard pagination bound; never imply the graph is complete.
wikikgextractor-summary: Introductory text shown above the local wiki extraction form.
wikikgextractor-permissiondenied: Permission error shown to users without the wikikgextractor-run right.
